title: Detailed heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff3366' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff3366' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='heartGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#e6003c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b30020'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shineGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0.5' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff99b3' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff99b3' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='highlightGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shadowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7a0018' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a0018' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  
  <!-- Main heart body -->
  <path d='M50 82 
           C50 82 14 56 14 36 
           C14 22 24 14 35 14 
           C43 14 48 20 50 26 
           C52 20 57 14 65 14 
           C76 14 86 22 86 36 
           C86 56 50 82 50 82 Z' 
        fill='url(#heartGrad)'/>
  
  <!-- Right lobe shadow -->
  <path d='M50 82 
           C50 82 86 56 86 36 
           C86 22 76 14 65 14 
           C57 14 52 20 50 26 Z' 
        fill='url(#shadowGrad)' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom point highlight -->
  <path d='M50 82 
           C50 82 42 72 42 64 
           C42 58 46 54 50 54 
           C54 54 58 58 58 64 
           C58 72 50 82 50 82 Z' 
        fill='#ff6b8a' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Left lobe shine -->
  <path d='M22 30 
           C22 24 28 18 35 18 
           C40 18 44 21 46 25 
           C47 28 46 32 42 34 
           C36 37 28 36 24 33 
           C22.5 32 22 31 22 30 Z' 
        fill='url(#highlightGrad)' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Small glossy dot -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='26' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-20 30 26)'/>
  
  <!-- Secondary shine -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='32' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.3' transform='rotate(-30 27 32)'/>
  
  <!-- Right lobe subtle shine -->
  <path d='M68 20 
           C72 20 78 24 79 30 
           C80 34 78 37 74 38 
           C70 39 66 36 65 32 
           C64.5 29 66 22 68 20 Z' 
        fill='#ff8fa8' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- Inner contour lines for detail -->
  <path d='M50 30 C50 30 40 24 34 26 C30 27.5 28 32 32 35 C36 38 44 38 50 34' 
        fill='none' stroke='#ff80a0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <path d='M50 34 C50 34 56 30 60 32 C63 33.5 64 37 61 39 C58 41 53 40 50 37' 
        fill='none' stroke='#ff80a0' stroke-width='1' stroke-opacity='0.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom contour detail -->
  <path d='M50 58 C50 58 44 62 44 68 C44 74 50 82 50 82' 
        fill='none' stroke='#ff6b8a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-opacity='0.35' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 C50 58 56 62 56 68 C56 74 50 82 50 82' 
        fill='none' stroke='#ff6b8a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-opacity='0.35' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Vein/branch details on left -->
  <path d='M38 28 C36 32 34 36 35 40' fill='none' stroke='#ff9aaa' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-opacity='0.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 30 C31 34 29 38 32 42' fill='none' stroke='#ff9aaa' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-opacity='0.25' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Vein details on right -->
  <path d='M62 28 C64 32 66 36 65 40' fill='none' stroke='#cc0030' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-opacity='0.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 32 C68 36 70 39 67 43' fill='none' stroke='#cc0030' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-opacity='0.25' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle -->
  <path d='M72 24 L73.5 27 L77 27.5 L74.5 30 L75.5 33 L72 31.5 L68.5 33 L69.5 30 L67 27.5 L70.5 27 Z' 
        fill='#ffe0e8' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
